[D] Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController manages the live document and canvas snapshot.
|   |-- private context: CanvasEditingContext; private snapshot: ControllerSnapshot
|   |-- private pendingNodeIds; private listeners; private nodeCache
|   |-- Opens a history context and uses injected diagram/history services.
|   |-- getSnapshot(); subscribe(listener); nodes()
|   `-- nodes() caches the display registry and returns a clone.
|-- Versioned edit entry points
|   |-- transact(expectedVersion, operations) calls applyUpdate.
|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion: number, operations: DiagramOperation[])
|   |-- Rejects a stale version and batches outside 1-100 operations.
|   |-- applyOperations stages a clone, then publishes one updated snapshot.
|   |-- prepareDiagramEdit(document, diagramId, edit)
|   |   `-- Calls diagrams.revise using the current staged diagram revision.
|   |-- DiagramOperation includes content edits, mappings, jumps and edge edits.
|   `-- Grid and floating move/collapse/remove paths use different geometry.
|-- Reconciliation and history publication
|   |-- Patch correspondence rebases edges, jumps, folds and section lines.
|   |-- trackNodes(ids); updateSnapshot(next, record, increment?)
|   |-- updateSnapshot normalizes views and reconciles recorded scene edits.
|   |-- historyService.append(context, next.document, next.canvas, pendingNodeIds)
|   |-- Transient layout updates can avoid history and version increments.
|   `-- commitDocument(document); select(command); undo(redo?); reset()
|-- Agent bridge manages polling and transport resources.
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge(descriptor, handle, workspace?)
|   |-- canvasId = crypto.randomUUID(); latest = useRef({ descriptor, handle })
|   |-- Registers the browser canvas and polls commands through apiFetch.
|   |-- await latest.current.handle(command)
|   |-- Keeps at most 200 result receipts; context reads are not cached.
|   |-- Cleanup aborts requests, clears retry timers and unregisters the instance.
|   `-- publishLiveCanvasSelections(workspace, canvasId, endpoint.href, setAgentStatus)
`-- MappingPage.handleAgentCommand dispatches into the workspace.
    |-- context: version, name, controller.nodes(), cloned edges
    |-- snapshot: controller.getSnapshot(), controller.exportHistory(), metadata
    |-- The document-state command reads the document and name.
    |-- apply: controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |-- Mutation request receipts prevent repeated apply/create/copy actions.
    |-- revisionReceiver.apply(id, payload, controller, persistenceCallback)
    |   `-- Its callback synchronizes persistence and awaits storage.flush().
    |-- copy-document: workspace.copyDocument(input)
    `-- Busy and unavailable documents are rejected before dependent edits.
